technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX, PSar, Supertrend) conflicts with weak momentum (RSI, MACD, price below key MAs) and below-cloud Ichimoku; insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 20 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with no significant insider conviction; news sentiment unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 20 days present binary event risk for industrials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX/PSar/Supertrend show strong trend structure with price near support (84.55), and extreme fear sentiment (18/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity for reversal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 312.3), all momentum indicators below 50 with no RSI confirmation, price below all key moving averages, below Ichimoku cloud, negative MACD, low volume (0.37 ratio), and earnings binary event in 20 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While ADX/PSar/Supertrend show structural strength and extreme fear presents contrarian opportunity, the confluence of macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 312.3), momentum collapse (all RSI below 50, MACD negative, price below all key MAs), and imminent earnings binary event creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 20 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signal and VIX crisis levels create binary downside risk that outweighs technical support structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 8 existing Industrials positions (26% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk during macro stress without fundamental or smart money support.
